source: git archive HEAD; every tracked tree entry; no local sessions, user config, secrets, network, builds or tests read/executed

patterns.research_zh: 科研|论文|文献|学术|综述|研究空白|证据集

methodology.matching: case-insensitive path and UTF-8 content union; candidate inventory, not semantic removal list or reachability proof; precise reviewed source lines are in the markdown report
methodology.binary: all filenames inventoried; binary/non-UTF8 content excluded from lexical scan; no image OCR
methodology.symlinks: tracked link target text scanned, not followed; AGENTS.md points to CLAUDE.md
methodology.areas: exclusive path-based ownership buckets; historical/proposal labels describe location, not a universal obsolescence ruling; specs describe design/status and are not runtime execution proof
methodology.counts: file counts, not occurrence or feature counts; area categories partition matched files; term and retained_asset sets overlap
exclusions: untracked files and concurrent worktree edits
real credentials, home configuration and real sessions

semantic_review.reachability_warning: Reviewed call paths are recorded in the markdown report; lexical hits and bundled assets alone do not prove reachability. No runtime behavior tested.

file_table_encoding.file_id: zero-based index into files; every baseline tracked path occurs exactly once
file_table_encoding.content_match: term_mask includes union of content and path; path_term_mask records filename matches; no source text or every-hit lines duplicated
file_table_encoding.example_query: files.filter(row => row[3] & term_bits.asci_brand_token); map row[0] for complete ASCI-token filename list
